description: This file defines a Polymer behavior for a custom element that has checked and ripple properties, extending multiple behaviors such as inky focus, iron checked, and paper checked behaviors. It includes script code implementing behavior logic and imports for dependencies.

methods.name: _checkedChanged
methods.description: Synchronizes the element's checked state with its ripple effect.

methods.name: _buttonStateChanged
methods.description: Synchronizes the element's active and checked state.
